description: U25 rung 3x (LOG 2026-11-21 17:59; outside the rules, unranked, no RL): D 007's architecture at 1024 x 24 (332M parameters, 64-wide heads, tied embeddings, TinyLlama tokenizer), Muon lr 4e-3 with the fused loss at micro-batch 64, up to 6.6B tokens or 330 minutes on one B200, the cosine ending on whichever runs out first. Data in two phases by run progress: mix_0.2.bin, then from half-way mix_0.2.bin 0.3125 / dm_math.bin 0.1875 / keyword-filtered FineMath-4plus 0.5 by rows (FineWeb-Edu 0.25, dm_math 0.25, FineMath 0.5). Then the base weights are probed. Run by scripts/research/u25_rung.sh.

u25.probe: python scripts/research/probe_reasoning.py --model <weights> --out-dir <this dir>/seeds/0/probe (defaults: sets A,B,C; 200 dev puzzles x 4 samples at temperature 1.0, 256 new tokens; GSM8K 100 train questions 4-shot greedy)
